payload.teachingGoal: Explain how DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces KV cache bottlenecks through architectural and precision co-optimization.
payload.learnerShouldUnderstand: The KV cache is the primary bottleneck for long-context agents, and it can be shrunk by reducing parameter activation, sharing data across layers, and lowering numerical precision.
payload.mentalModel: A high-speed library where storage space is limited; we save room by using thinner books, sharing one copy of a book across multiple floors, and only reading the most relevant pages.

beats.purpose: Establish the KV cache as the primary bottleneck in long-context serving.
beats.narrationDraft: In long-context AI, the KV cache stores past token states, but its massive size strains memory and bandwidth.
beats.intentionalPause: Short pause to visualize memory pressure.

beats.purpose: Explain how the Causal Encoder-Decoder reduces prefill computation.
beats.narrationDraft: The Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture activates only 8B parameters during prefill, halving the initial computation cost for new inputs.
beats.intentionalPause: Brief pause to emphasize the 8B vs 16B parameter split.

beats.purpose: Describe the cross-layer reuse mechanism of CSA2.
beats.narrationDraft: Compressed Sparse Attention 2 shares KV data across layers, eliminating redundant storage while maintaining high performance through sparse selection.
beats.intentionalPause: Pause to visualize layers sharing a single cache.

beats.purpose: Explain the impact of FP4 quantization on the cache footprint.
beats.narrationDraft: By quantizing the global KV cache to FP4 precision, the model shrinks its memory footprint to 890 bytes per token.
beats.intentionalPause: Pause on the 890 bytes per token figure.

beats.purpose: Explain how SWA Bounded Replay reduces persistent storage needs.
beats.narrationDraft: SWA Bounded Replay avoids storing local states on SSD by approximately reconstructing them through a small, efficient recomputation.
beats.intentionalPause: Pause to consider the SSD storage savings.

beats.purpose: Summarize the total reduction in cache footprint.
beats.narrationDraft: Together, these mechanisms reduce the persistent cache to 1/8th the size of previous models, enabling massive context horizons.
beats.intentionalPause: Final pause for the 1/8th reduction claim.
